question: Can multiple unsupervised clustering families produce non-degenerate, interpretable Lead, Spot and Broker profiles that carry future scheduled-visit signal?
hypothesis: A balance-aware unsupervised benchmark can avoid the ~90% dominant Lead/Spot clusters while preserving stable separation and useful future lift.
primary_change: Replace K-Means-only entity profiling with outcome-free multi-method clustering selection based on separation, balance and stability.
secondary_changes: Freeze all profile discovery in an early temporal calibration window to remove broker-profile look-ahead.

target.censoring: The public data has no visit timestamp; the recorded inquiry response is treated as the observed proxy outcome and this limitation is reported.

population.eligibility: Inquiries after a frozen early profile-calibration window; the final 20% by inquiry_at is held out for future evaluation.
exclusions: The first 30% of inquiries are reserved only for unsupervised profile calibration and are not used to fit the predictive models.

validation.split_description: First 30% of inquiries calibrate/freeze unsupervised profiles; next 50% train the predictive model; final 20% are an untouched future test.

items.evidence: Profile uses lead-declared fields and prior-history fields present on the lead row; the clusterer is fitted only in the early calibration window.

items.information_available_at: spot listing fields available by the inquiry timestamp
items.evidence: Profile excludes days_on_market, total_inquiries, total_views and is_active; clusterer is fitted in the early calibration window and then frozen.

items.source: spots and inquiries from the first 30% temporal calibration window
items.information_available_at: strictly before the predictive train window begins
items.evidence: Broker portfolio/response history is computed only in the early calibration window and frozen before any predictive training or test row.

items.source: derived from lead_profile_v2, spot_profile_v2 and broker_profile_v2
items.evidence: Interactions contain no new information beyond the reviewed profile IDs.
